whenToUse: The last item was removed from a cart, folder, or playlist.
It may have been removed by mistake.
There's a natural next action after emptying (continue shopping).
whenNotToUse: Screens empty from the start (use an empty state).
It's empty because every task is done (use all caught up).
Irreversible deletion (ask first with a confirmation dialog).

alternatives.name: Undo
alternatives.reason: Undoing a deletion while the list still has items.

alternatives.name: All Caught Up
alternatives.reason: It's empty because everything was handled.

accessibility: The removed item and its button disappear, so move focus to the empty state's heading.
Put the removed item's name in the description to say what's gone.
Undoing returns focus to the item's remove button.
The next action is a real link, so default behavior such as opening in a new tab works.
